cards.ex: Maya ran into her cousin Tom on the train home, so they sat together.
cards.exru: По дороге домой Майя случайно встретила в поезде своего двоюродного брата Тома, и они сели вместе.
cards.note: В разговоре run into someone описывает неожиданную встречу. Имя или местоимение ставят после into. Можно сказать I ran into her. Форма I ran her into для этого значения ошибочна. Если о встрече договорились заранее, подойдёт meet up with someone.

sources.evidence: The COBUILD entry puts the person after into and illustrates a chance encounter with the past-tense form ran.
sources.title: RUN INTO definition and meaning | Collins English Dictionary

sources.evidence: The B2 entry for run into someone describes unexpectedly seeing someone you know and lists ran and run as the past forms.
sources.title: RUN (SOMETHING) INTO SOMETHING/SOMEONE - Cambridge English Dictionary

sources.evidence: The British entry gives the contrasting sense of a meeting that people have arranged in advance.
sources.title: MEET UP definition and meaning | Collins English Dictionary
